Equipment: The Grail posts bounties and hazard notices. Protection Coverage sells to communities like Hush, with prices climbing alongside sightings. Soulspire supplies, looses, owns, or attracts dangerous soul-resonant assets. Kazrak holds the Preserve concession and reclassified the workers who became the Bramble Union. The capital ward depends on old forest-magic while the system fear-sells the forest.
